statements.status_notes: CVE-2024-27281 (GHSA-592j-995h-p23j): RDoc 6.3.3 through 6.6.2 can deserialize arbitrary objects from a crafted .rdoc_options file, or load a crafted cache, which can lead to code execution. It is fixed in RDoc 6.3.4.1, 6.4.1.1, 6.5.1.1 and 6.6.3.1, and Ruby 3.3.1 and later ship RDoc 6.6.3.1: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-592j-995h-p23j, https://www.ruby-lang.org/en/news/2024/03/21/rce-rdoc-cve-2024-27281/. Listed the files of every package built from the ruby-3.3 source in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, on x86_64 and aarch64: the interpreter packages ruby-3.3, ruby-3.3-libs, ruby-3.3-dev, ruby-3.3-doc, ruby-3.3-dbg and ruby-3.3-full, 3.3.10-r0 through the current 3.3.14-r4 (ruby-3.3-libs and ruby-3.3-full 3.3.11-r1 are published for aarch64 only), and the bundled-gem packages ruby3.3-bundler, ruby3.3-debug, ruby3.3-matrix, ruby3.3-minitest, ruby3.3-net-ftp, ruby3.3-net-imap, ruby3.3-net-pop, ruby3.3-net-smtp, ruby3.3-power_assert, ruby3.3-prime, ruby3.3-racc, ruby3.3-rake, ruby3.3-rbs, ruby3.3-rdoc, ruby3.3-rexml, ruby3.3-rss, ruby3.3-test-unit and ruby3.3-typeprof, -r0 through -r4 (ruby3.3-net-imap is 0.4.21-r0 through 0.4.21-r3, 0.4.25-r3 and 0.4.25-r4). Each bundled-gem package carries its gem's version, not Ruby's (for example ruby3.3-rexml 3.4.4-r0). RDoc ships in two of them: its library in ruby-3.3-libs, where usr/lib/ruby/3.3.0/rdoc/version.rb reads 6.6.3.1 in every published build on both architectures, and its gem specification in ruby3.3-rdoc, which installs rdoc-6.6.3.1.gemspec in every published build although the package is labelled 6.14.0. No build installs any other RDoc version. ruby3.3-rbs (3.4.0-r0 through 3.4.0-r4) carries usr/lib/ruby/gems/3.3.0/gems/rbs-3.4.0/Gemfile.lock, which names RDoc 6.6.2: the development lockfile that ships inside the bundled rbs gem and records the gems rbs's own developers locked; it is a text file that neither Ruby nor RubyGems reads when loading gems. Because every published build carries the fix, the range is fixed at the lowest version the owner publishes, 0.1.2-r0 (ruby3.3-net-pop and ruby3.3-prime), so that every published build reads as fixed.

CVE-2024-27281 (GHSA-592j-995h-p23j): RDoc 6.3.3 through 6.6.2 can deserialize arbitrary objects from a crafted .rdoc_options file, or load a crafted cache, which can lead to code execution. It is fixed in RDoc 6.3.4.1, 6.4.1.1, 6.5.1.1 and 6.6.3.1, and Ruby 3.3.1 and later ship RDoc 6.6.3.1: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-592j-995h-p23j, https://www.ruby-lang.org/en/news/2024/03/21/rce-rdoc-cve-2024-27281/. Listed the files of every ruby-3.3 and ruby-3.3-dev package published in the DHI Debian 13 repository, on amd64 and arm64: 80 versions, 3.3.11-0 through the current 3.3.14-0. Every ruby-3.3 build installs RDoc 6.6.3.1 as a default gem (usr/lib/ruby/gems/3.3.0/specifications/default/rdoc-6.6.3.1.gemspec), and no build installs any other RDoc version. Every ruby-3.3 build also carries usr/lib/ruby/gems/3.3.0/gems/rbs-3.4.0/Gemfile.lock, which names RDoc 6.6.2: the development lockfile that ships inside the bundled rbs gem and records the gems rbs's own developers locked; it is a text file that neither Ruby nor RubyGems reads when loading gems. Because every published build carries the fix, the range is fixed at the first published build, 3.3.11-0.
